start.text: That one in the window? Six thousand five hundred. Spruce top, decent tuners. Half this city learnt Wonderwall on this model and the other half pretends it didn't.

booked.text: Ah - that one's the display piece, booked till Tuesday. New stock comes Tuesday. Take my number, come Tuesday, I'll keep one aside. Six-five, no bargaining - I'm not the cycle uncle.

wish.text: Then come back when it isn't. It'll still be six-five; I don't do sales, I do tuning. (He writes GUITAR - TUESDAY on a card and hands it to you anyway.)

again.text: Tuesday. I remember you. The spruce top is still six-five and still in the window.

tuesday.text: Tuesday. I said Tuesday and here you are. Spruce top, strung this morning, tuned twice. Six-five, same as I said.

sold.text: Good. Pick and a chord chart, free - G, C, D, I've circled them. Three chords and you can play half the songs in this city. Wipe the strings after.

later.text: It waits till Saturday. After that I'm not promising - students come in on Saturdays with their fathers' money.

owned.text: How's the spruce top? If your fingers hurt, you're doing it right. If they bleed, you're doing it wrong.
